author: sacnaik

#### Description


SONiC provides gbsyncd.service.j2 build template file for gbsyncd systemd service. Currently the service template file is used for VS and other platforms are required to create symlink. 

SONiC provides flexibility that each vendor can define platform specific Makefile to build chip specific gbsyncd docker(Ex gbsyncd-credo).  It would be clean if SONiC provides common gbsyncd.service.j2 to start for  platform specific  gbsyncd docker instead of vendor to provide symlink. Ex: gbsyncd-credo.service.j2 -> gbsyncd.service.j2

#### Why I did it
Fix #9059. It provides common gbsyncd.service.j2 to start for platform specific gbsyncd docker, which must be named 'gbsyncd'. 

#### How I did it
1. All of platform specific gbsyncd dockers use a common name 'gbsyncd'
2. Use a unique systemd service template gbsyncd.service.j2 for gbsyncd docker
